items.source: Returns the underlying CassandraPersistentProperty backing the field. For path traversals this will be the property that represents the value to handle. This means it'll be the leaf property for plain paths or the association property in case we refer to an association somewhere in the path.
items.translation: 返回支持该字段的底层 CassandraPersistentProperty。对于路径遍历，这将代表要处理的值的属性。这意味着对于普通路径，它将是叶属性；如果路径中引用了关联，则它将是关联属性。
